title: Color Gradient Cards
shareTitle: Color Gradient Cards 🎨 — A Papercraft Color Atelier
description: Arrange tactile paper shades from light to dark, reveal bridges between mixed colors, and find exact matches in a papercraft nature safari. A calm color-discrimination game for ages 5–6.
learningGoals: Discriminate and order nearby shades by lightness
Observe the transition between two primary colors
Match an object's visible color to an exact shade card
interactionModel: Custom papercraft atelier: drag cards into padded rack, press, and specimen targets, or use the equivalent tap-card then tap-target path
feedbackModel: Correct cards snap into place with chromatic notes and recorded praise; close attempts wobble gently, return in place, and preserve all progress.
credits: Kaigani; papercraft art generated with OpenAI gpt-image-2, then authored, extracted, recolored, and normalized for QLOBE Kids. Voice generated locally and transcript-checked with Whisper. Built with Codex for QLOBE Kids.
